anomalies.title: Elevated Days Sales Outstanding (DSO Spikes)
anomalies.description: DSO of 65.7 days significantly exceeds the 60-day healthy benchmark.
anomalies.risk_explanation: Capital tied up in receivables; elevated default risk on aging accounts.
anomalies.recommended_remediation: Enforce strict 30-day payment terms and issue immediate credit holds for delinquent accounts.

anomalies.title: Audit Disclosures Alert: Pending Material Litigation
anomalies.description: Notes to Accounts disclosures contain audit warning trigger phrase 'litigation'.
anomalies.risk_explanation: Pending legal claims or litigation proceedings disclosed.
anomalies.recommended_remediation: Conduct targeted credit review and request detailed accounting disclosure clarification.
